#!/bin/bash
# S40 (reviewer) — independent review harness for souji-shokunin tools/souji-verify.sh
# Deterministic: builds an isolated fixture world under mktemp -d; writes only
# into $OUTDIR (default /tmp/s40-review) and the mktemp world (cleaned on demand).
# Usage: MODE=build|run bash harness.sh
set -uo pipefail

TOOL=${TOOL:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/tools/souji-verify.sh}
OUTDIR=${OUTDIR:-/tmp/s40-review}
FLEET=${FLEET:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin}
LANE=${LANE:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin}
MODE=${MODE:-run}

W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s40-world.XXXXXX)
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
CASES="$OUTDIR/cases.tsv";  : > "$CASES"
LIVE="$OUTDIR/live.tsv";    : > "$LIVE"
EXTRA="$OUTDIR/extra.txt";  : > "$EXTRA"
FIND="$OUTDIR/findings.tsv";: > "$FIND"

# --- tool invocation form -------------------------------------------------
TOOLCMD=("$TOOL")
[ -x "$TOOL" ] || TOOLCMD=(bash "$TOOL")

gq() { git -c user.name=S40 -c user.email=s40@fixture.local -c init.defaultBranch=master "$@"; }

record() { # file id pass expect exit verdict receipt evidence
  local f="$1" id="$2" pass="$3" expect="$4" ec="$5" v="$6" r="$7" ev="$8"
  ev=${ev//$'\t'/ }
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$pass" "$expect" "$ec" "$v" "$r" "$ev" >> "$f"
}
note() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$EXTRA"; }
finding() { printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" >> "$FIND"; }

call_tool() { # args...; sets RC LINE FULLOUT ; SR = SHOKUNIN_ROOT override
  FULLOUT=$(env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="${SR:-$W}" "${TOOLCMD[@]}" "$@" 2>&1); RC=$?
  LINE=$(printf '%s\n' "$FULLOUT" | head -n1)
  V_VERDICT=""; V_RECEIPT=""; V_EVID=""; V_PATH=""
  if [ -n "$LINE" ]; then IFS=$'\t' read -r _TAG V_PATH V_VERDICT V_RECEIPT V_EVID <<<"$LINE"; fi
}

verdict_is() { [ "${V_VERDICT:-}" = "$1" ]; }
receipt_is() { [ "${V_RECEIPT:-}" = "$1" ]; }
receipt_in() { local x; for x in "$@"; do [ "${V_RECEIPT:-}" = "$x" ] && return 0; done; return 1; }

# ======================= fixture world =====================================
build_world() {
  mkdir -p "$W/world" "$W/wt" "$W/corpus/knowledge" "$W/vault" \
           "$W/souji-shokunin/census" "$W/world/arts" "$W/world/sec" "$W/world/out-of-repo"
  # fixture lane repo (mirrors SHOKUNIN_ROOT/*-shokunin shape for owner scanning)
  gq -C "$W/souji-shokunin" init -q
  echo "s40 fixture lane" > "$W/souji-shokunin/README.md"
  gq -C "$W/souji-shokunin" add README.md; gq -C "$W/souji-shokunin" commit -qm "fixture lane c0"

  # --- RA: pushed repo, origin/HEAD -> refs/remotes/origin/main (F1, D1 symref path)
  RA="$W/world/ra"; mkdir -p "$RA/pre"
  gq -C "$RA" init -q
  echo "f1 payload" > "$RA/pre/f1.txt"
  gq -C "$RA" add pre/f1.txt; gq -C "$RA" commit -qm "add f1"
  echo "tip" > "$RA/README"; gq -C "$RA" add README; gq -C "$RA" commit -qm "tip"
  gq -C "$RA" branch -f main HEAD
  gq -C "$RA" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main HEAD
  gq -C "$RA" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main

  # --- RL: local-only introducing commit (F2) — origin/master behind it
  RL="$W/world/rl"; mkdir -p "$RL/pre"
  gq -C "$RL" init -q
  echo "root" > "$RL/README"; gq -C "$RL" add README; gq -C "$RL" commit -qm "c0"
  RL_C0=$(git -C "$RL" rev-parse HEAD)
  echo "f2 payload" > "$RL/pre/f2.txt"; gq -C "$RL" add pre/f2.txt; gq -C "$RL" commit -qm "A: add f2 (local only)"
  RL_A=$(git -C "$RL" rev-parse HEAD)
  echo "tip2" >> "$RL/README"; gq -C "$RL" add README; gq -C "$RL" commit -qm "B: tip"
  gq -C "$RL" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$RL_C0"

  # --- RD: repo-root, unpushed commit + dirty tree (F3, kotodama-shaped)
  RD="$W/world/rd"; mkdir -p "$RD"
  gq -C "$RD" init -q
  echo "a" > "$RD/a.txt"; gq -C "$RD" add a.txt; gq -C "$RD" commit -qm "c0"
  echo "b" > "$RD/b.txt"; gq -C "$RD" add b.txt; gq -C "$RD" commit -qm "c1 local-only"
  echo "dirty" >> "$RD/a.txt"

  # --- OWNER: worktree registrations (F4, F5, F5b)
  O="$W/owner-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$O"
  gq -C "$O" init -q
  echo "o" > "$O/o.txt"; gq -C "$O" add o.txt; gq -C "$O" commit -qm "oc0"
  OC=$(git -C "$O" rev-parse HEAD)
  gq -C "$O" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$OC"
  gq -C "$O" worktree add -q --detach "$W/wt/wt-gone" HEAD
  rm -rf "$W/wt/wt-gone"
  gq -C "$O" worktree add -q -b bfix "$W/wt/wt-branch" HEAD
  echo "x" > "$W/wt/wt-branch/bf.txt"
  gq -C "$W/wt/wt-branch" add bf.txt; gq -C "$W/wt/wt-branch" commit -qm "bfix local-only work"
  rm -rf "$W/wt/wt-branch"
  gq -C "$O" worktree add -q -b blive "$W/wt/wt-live" HEAD
  echo "untracked" > "$W/wt/wt-live/untracked.txt"

  # --- ledger (F6 / F6n) at $W/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv
  LK="$W/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
  printf 'source_path\tsource_sha256\tvault_path\tvault_sha256\texported_at\tnote\n' > "$LK"
  echo "archived payload s40" > "$W/world/arts/lf.txt"
  cp "$W/world/arts/lf.txt" "$W/vault/lf.txt"
  s1=$(sha256sum "$W/world/arts/lf.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  v1=$(sha256sum "$W/vault/lf.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18T00:00:00Z\ts40-fixture\n' "$W/world/arts/lf.txt" "$s1" "$W/vault/lf.txt" "$v1" >> "$LK"
  # F6n1: source sha ok, vault sha mismatched
  echo "bad payload" > "$W/world/arts/lf-bad.txt"
  echo "different vault copy" > "$W/vault/lf-bad.txt"
  sb=$(sha256sum "$W/world/arts/lf-bad.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  vb=$(sha256sum "$W/vault/lf-bad.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  vb_wrong=$(printf 'wrong-%s' "$vb" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18T00:00:00Z\ts40-fixture-bad-vault\n' "$W/world/arts/lf-bad.txt" "$sb" "$W/vault/lf-bad.txt" "$vb_wrong" >> "$LK"
  # F6n2: source file changed after export (source sha mismatch)
  echo "mod payload" > "$W/world/arts/lf-mod.txt"
  cp "$W/world/arts/lf-mod.txt" "$W/vault/lf-mod.txt"
  s2=$(sha256sum "$W/world/arts/lf-mod.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  v2=$(sha256sum "$W/vault/lf-mod.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo "modified after export" >> "$W/world/arts/lf-mod.txt"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18T00:00:00Z\ts40-fixture-mod\n' "$W/world/arts/lf-mod.txt" "$s2" "$W/vault/lf-mod.txt" "$v2" >> "$LK"
  note "ledger rows: 3 (lf ok; lf-bad vault-sha mismatch; lf-mod source-sha mismatch)"

  # --- scratch fixtures inside a repo RP (F7, F7n, F8, threshold)
  RP="$W/world/rp"; mkdir -p "$RP"
  gq -C "$RP" init -q
  echo "rp" > "$RP/README"; gq -C "$RP" add README; gq -C "$RP" commit -qm "rp0"
  mkdir -p "$RP/sc1" "$RP/sc2" "$RP/sc3" "$RP/sc4" "$RP/sc5" "$RP/refs" "$RP/souji-shokunin/census"
  echo "keep payload" > "$RP/sc1/zq7x-keep.out";   touch -d '3 days ago' "$RP/sc1/zq7x-keep.out"
  echo "census payload" > "$RP/sc2/zq7x-census.out"; touch -d '3 days ago' "$RP/sc2/zq7x-census.out"
  echo "live payload" > "$RP/sc3/zq7x-live.out";   touch -d '3 days ago' "$RP/sc3/zq7x-live.out"
  echo "fresh payload" > "$RP/sc4/zq7x-new.out"
  echo "old payload" > "$RP/sc5/zq7x-old5.out";    touch -d '3 days ago' "$RP/sc5/zq7x-old5.out"
  echo "live reference to zq7x-live.out lives here" > "$RP/refs/live.md"
  mkdir -p "$RP/sc3b"; echo "another live artifact named zq7x-live.out" > "$RP/sc3b/zq7x-live.out"
  echo 'mentions zq7x-census.out (census-like, must be excluded)' > "$RP/souji-shokunin/census/fake.json"
  echo 'mentions zq7x-census.out (census-like, must be excluded)' > "$W/souji-shokunin/census/fake.json"
  # out-of-repo scratch shape (observation only)
  echo "out payload" > "$W/world/out-of-repo/zq7x-outside.out"; touch -d '3 days ago' "$W/world/out-of-repo/zq7x-outside.out"

  # --- secrets-shaped dummies (F10) — dummy content only, never read by this harness
  mkdir -p "$W/world/sec"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec/.env"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec/dummy.env"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec/credentials.json"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec/id_dummy"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec/key.pem"
  mkdir -p "$W/world/sec2/.env"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec2/.env/inner.txt"
  printf 'S40-DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET\n' > "$W/world/sec2/mysecrets.txt"
}

fixture_facts() {
  note "== fixture facts (independent derivations) =="
  note "world=$W"
  note "f1 introducing: $(git -C "$RA" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- pre/f1.txt) ; ancestor of refs/remotes/origin/main: $(git -C "$RA" merge-base --is-ancestor "$(git -C "$RA" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- pre/f1.txt)" refs/remotes/origin/main && echo yes || echo no)"
  note "f2 introducing: $RL_A ; ancestor of refs/remotes/origin/master: $(git -C "$RL" merge-base --is-ancestor "$RL_A" refs/remotes/origin/master && echo yes || echo no)"
  note "rd unpushed(--branches --not --remotes)=$(git -C "$RD" log --branches --not --remotes --oneline | wc -l) dirty=$(git -C "$RD" status --porcelain | wc -l)"
  note "owner porcelain:"
  git -C "$O" worktree list --porcelain | sed 's/^/  owner| /' >> "$EXTRA"
  note "wt-gone dir exists: $([ -e "$W/wt/wt-gone" ] && echo yes || echo no); unique(HEAD)=$(git -C "$O" log --oneline "$OC" --not --all | wc -l)"
  note "wt-branch exists: $([ -e "$W/wt/wt-branch" ] && echo yes || echo no); bfix unpushed(-not --remotes)=$(git -C "$O" log --oneline bfix --not --remotes | wc -l)"
  note "wt-live exists: $([ -e "$W/wt/wt-live" ] && echo yes || echo no); dirty=$(git -C "$W/wt/wt-live" status --porcelain | wc -l)"
  note "rg version: $(rg --version | head -n1)"
  note "spec-literal rg --basename probe: stderr=$(rg -l --no-ignore --basename zq7x-keep.out "$W" 2>&1 >/dev/null | head -n1) rc=$(rg -l --no-ignore --basename zq7x-keep.out "$W" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)"
  note "content-sweep zq7x-keep.out (self+all): $(rg -l --no-ignore zq7x-keep.out "$W" -g '!.git' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  note "content-sweep zq7x-live.out (self+all): $(rg -l --no-ignore zq7x-live.out "$W" -g '!.git' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  note "content-sweep zq7x-census.out (census excluded): $(rg -l --no-ignore zq7x-census.out "$W" -g '!.git' -g '!souji-shokunin/census/**' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  note "content-sweep zq7x-census.out (census included): $(rg -l --no-ignore zq7x-census.out "$W" -g '!.git' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
}

# ======================= cases =============================================
run_cases() {
  # F1
  call_tool "$RA/pre/f1.txt"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is pushed; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F1 "$p" "SAFE|pushed" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F2
  call_tool "$RL/pre/f2.txt"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && receipt_in none pushed-unverifiable; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F2 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|none|pushed-unverifiable" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F3
  call_tool "$RD"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && [[ "${V_EVID:-}" =~ unpushed=[0-9]+\ dirty=[0-9]+ ]]; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F3 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|unpushed=N dirty=M" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F4
  call_tool "$W/wt/wt-gone"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is metadata-prune; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F4 "$p" "SAFE|metadata-prune" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F5
  call_tool "$W/wt/wt-branch"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && receipt_is unpushed-branch; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F5 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|unpushed-branch" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F5b (dir present + dirty)
  call_tool "$W/wt/wt-live"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && receipt_is dirty; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F5b "$p" "NOT-SAFE|dirty" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F6
  call_tool "$W/world/arts/lf.txt"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is moved-to-obsidian; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F6 "$p" "SAFE|moved-to-obsidian" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F6n1 vault sha mismatch
  call_tool "$W/world/arts/lf-bad.txt"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && ! receipt_is moved-to-obsidian; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F6n1 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|!=moved-to-obsidian" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F6n2 source sha mismatch
  call_tool "$W/world/arts/lf-mod.txt"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && ! receipt_is moved-to-obsidian; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F6n2 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|!=moved-to-obsidian" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F7
  call_tool "$RP/sc1/zq7x-keep.out"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is stale; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F7 "$p" "SAFE|stale" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F8
  call_tool "$RP/sc2/zq7x-census.out"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is stale; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F8 "$p" "SAFE|stale (census excluded)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F7n live reference
  call_tool "$RP/sc3/zq7x-live.out"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && ! receipt_is stale; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F7n "$p" "NOT-SAFE|!=stale" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F7n2 fresh mtime
  call_tool "$RP/sc4/zq7x-new.out"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && ! receipt_is stale; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" F7n2 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|!=stale (fresh)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # threshold direction
  call_tool --stale-days 5 "$RP/sc5/zq7x-old5.out"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && ! receipt_is stale; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" Fthr5 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|!=stale (3d < 5d)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"
  call_tool --stale-days 1 "$RP/sc5/zq7x-old5.out"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is stale; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" Fthr1 "$p" "SAFE|stale (3d > 1d)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # F10 secrets refusal (7 shapes)
  local i=0 f
  local -a sf=( "$W/world/sec/.env" "$W/world/sec/dummy.env" "$W/world/sec/credentials.json" \
                "$W/world/sec/id_dummy" "$W/world/sec/key.pem" \
                "$W/world/sec2/.env/inner.txt" "$W/world/sec2/mysecrets.txt" )
  for f in "${sf[@]}"; do
    i=$((i+1))
    call_tool "$f"
    if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && receipt_is secrets-refusal; then p=1; else p=0; fi
    record "$CASES" "F10-$i" "$p" "NOT-SAFE|secrets-refusal" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}" "${f##*/}"
  done

  # CLI: missing target
  call_tool "$W/nope/nothing-here"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && receipt_is unreachable; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" CLI-missing "$p" "NOT-SAFE|unreachable exit0" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # CLI: unknown flag -> exit 2
  call_tool --bogus-flag "$RA/pre/f1.txt"
  if [ "$RC" = 2 ]; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" CLI-usage "$p" "exit=2" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # CLI: no args (observe)
  call_tool
  record "$CASES" CLI-noargs "0" "observe" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # CLI: --json parses and matches text verdicts (JSONL: one object per target)
  local jout jrc
  jout=$(env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$W" "${TOOLCMD[@]}" --json "$RA/pre/f1.txt" "$W/world/sec/dummy.env" 2>&1); jrc=$?
  if [ "$jrc" = 0 ] && printf '%s' "$jout" | python3 -c '
import json,sys
s=sys.stdin.read()
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in s.splitlines() if l.strip()]
vs=[r.get("verdict") for r in rows]
assert "SAFE" in vs and "NOT-SAFE" in vs, vs
' 2>"$OUTDIR/json-err.txt"; then p=1; else p=0; fi
record "$CASES" CLI-json "$p" "valid JSON(L) w/ both verdicts (exit 0)" "$jrc" "" "" "$(printf '%s' "$jout" | head -c 200)"
  printf '%s\n' "$jout" > "$OUTDIR/json-output.txt"

  # selftest x2
  local t0 t1 st1 st2
  t0=$(date +%s); env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$W" "${TOOLCMD[@]}" --selftest >"$OUTDIR/selftest-1.out" 2>&1; st1=$?; t1=$(date +%s)
  env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$W" "${TOOLCMD[@]}" --selftest >"$OUTDIR/selftest-2.out" 2>&1; st2=$?
  if [ "$st1" = 0 ] && [ "$st2" = 0 ]; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" SELFTEST "$p" "exit 0 twice" "$st1" "" "" "run2=$st2 wall=$((t1-t0))s"

  # stability: repeat F4 + F7 + live kotodama later; repeat here F4/F7
  call_tool "$W/wt/wt-gone"; r1="${V_VERDICT}|${V_RECEIPT}"
  call_tool "$W/wt/wt-gone"; r2="${V_VERDICT}|${V_RECEIPT}"
  if [ "$r1" = "$r2" ] && [ "$r1" = "SAFE|metadata-prune" ]; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$CASES" REPEAT-F4 "$p" "stable SAFE|metadata-prune" "0" "" "" "$r1 vs $r2"

  # observe: stale-shaped file outside any git repo
  call_tool "$W/world/out-of-repo/zq7x-outside.out"
  record "$CASES" OBS-outside-repo "0" "observe" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"
}

# ======================= live checks (read-only) ===========================
run_live() {
  SR="$FLEET"
  local kt="$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" lane_head lane_status

  # L1 kotodama (drift-tolerant: tool counts must equal independent re-derivation)
  call_tool "$kt"
  kt_unp=$(git -C "$kt" log --oneline HEAD --not --remotes | wc -l)
  kt_dirty=$(git -C "$kt" status --porcelain | wc -l)
  local tu td
  tu=$(printf '%s' "${V_EVID:-}" | sed -n 's/.*unpushed=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  td=$(printf '%s' "${V_EVID:-}" | sed -n 's/.*dirty=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && [ -n "$tu" ] && [ -n "$td" ] \
     && [ "$((10#$tu))" = "$kt_unp" ] && [ "$((10#$tu))" -ge 1 ] \
     && [ "$((10#$td - 10#$kt_dirty))" -le 1 ] && [ "$((10#$kt_dirty - 10#$td))" -le 1 ]; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$LIVE" L1-kotodama "$p" "NOT-SAFE; unpushed==independent>=1; dirty within +/-1" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "tool=${V_EVID:-} | independent: unpushed=$kt_unp dirty=$kt_dirty"

  # L2 fleet-root pushed file (D1 symref path on live origin/master)
  call_tool "$FLEET/AXES.md"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is pushed; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$LIVE" L2-fleet-AXES-pushed "$p" "SAFE|pushed (origin/HEAD->master)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # L3 lore prunable detached worktree (dir absent, unique=0)
  local lp hdr
  lp=$(pick_prunable "$FLEET/lore-shokunin" detached)
  note "lore pick=$lp exists=$([ -e "$lp" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  if [ -n "$lp" ]; then
    call_tool "$lp"
    hdr=$(git -C "$FLEET/lore-shokunin" worktree list --porcelain | awk -v p="$lp" '$1=="worktree"{w=$2} w==p && $1=="HEAD"{print $2}')
    local uniq; uniq=$(git -C "$FLEET/lore-shokunin" log --oneline "$hdr" --not --all | wc -l)
    if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is metadata-prune; then p=1; else p=0; fi
    record "$LIVE" L3-lore-prune "$p" "SAFE|metadata-prune (unique=0)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "independent unique=$uniq"
  else
    record "$LIVE" L3-lore-prune "0" "SAFE|metadata-prune" "-1" "" "" "no prunable detached worktree found"
  fi

  # L4 gd2d named-branch worktree with 1 unpushed commit
  local gp
  gp="$FLEET/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r100"
  call_tool "$gp"
  local gd_unp; gd_unp=$(git -C "$FLEET/game-dev-2d-shokunin" log --oneline wt-r100 --not --remotes | wc -l)
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is NOT-SAFE && receipt_is unpushed-branch; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$LIVE" L4-gd2d-wt-r100 "$p" "NOT-SAFE|unpushed-branch" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "tool=${V_EVID:-} | independent bfix-unpushed=$gd_unp"

  # L5 gd2d detached prunable (r80)
  call_tool "$FLEET/r80-baseline-frozen-worktree"
  if [ "$RC" = 0 ] && verdict_is SAFE && receipt_is metadata-prune; then p=1; else p=0; fi
  record "$LIVE" L5-gd2d-r80 "$p" "SAFE|metadata-prune" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # L6 lane file (souji LOG.md) — spec fallback-3 observation
  call_tool "$LANE/LOG.md"
  record "$LIVE" L6-lane-file "0" "observe (fallback-3: no origin refs, local master)" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-}"

  # L7 fleet root itself — observe
  call_tool "$FLEET"
  kt_dirty=$(git -C "$FLEET" status --porcelain | wc -l)
  record "$LIVE" L7-fleet-root "0" "observe" "$RC" "${V_VERDICT:-}" "${V_RECEIPT:-}" "${V_EVID:-} dirty(independent)=$kt_dirty"

  SR="$W"
}

pick_prunable() { # repo, mode(detached|named) -> path of first prunable+dir-absent worktree
  local repo="$1" mode="$2" path="" cur=""
  while IFS= read -r ln; do
    case "$ln" in
      "worktree "*) path="${ln#worktree }" ;;
      "branch "*) cur="named" ;;
      "detached"*) cur="detached" ;;
      "prunable"*)
        if [ -n "$path" ] && [ ! -e "$path" ]; then
          if [ "$mode" = "$cur" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$path"; return 0; fi
        fi
        ;;
      "") path=""; cur="" ;;
    esac
  done < <(git -C "$repo" worktree list --porcelain)
  return 1
}
